page.content:
Habit of footnoting and tagging unsourced lines as a civic practice.

How Citation culture connects

  • Topic: Verifiability — The verifiability policy produced Wikipedia's visible citation-needed culture.
  • Topic: Featured article — Featured-article review demands the dense sourcing citation culture prizes.

What is Citation culture?

Wikipedia's citation culture — templates, citation-needed tags, and featured-article source reviews — made referencing a visible part of the page, not just an academic appendix.

Key threads lead to Verifiability and Featured article.
